One context layer, shared by every agent.

Book a demoHow it works

Three kinds of context. Any number of readers.

Skills are how work gets done. Knowledge is what is true. Metrics are what words mean. Each is kept once, in Atlas, and every agent reads the same copy.

Everything Atlas keeps, and how it keeps it.

Pick a type of context to see what it looks like inside Atlas, or a mechanism to see how it is kept honest.

01

Skills

How a job is done here. A skill is a written procedure that agents follow. Each save is a new version with a note on what changed, and an owner can restore any older one.

skill · month-end-close · v0.1.4 · published

02

Knowledge

What is true here. Pages your team writes together in a live editor, with comments, tasks and links between pages. Agents read the same pages people do.

page · finance / payout schedule · live

03

Metrics

What a word means here. A metric is SQL over your BigQuery or Snowflake warehouse, agreed once. Tables carry notes on how to use them, and every agent answers from the same definition.

metric · active customers · bigquery · run preview

04

Scopes

Who may see it. Pages and skills sit in a teamspace or in someone's private space, with view, comment, edit or full access. An agent never sees more than the person it works for.

scope · finance › payout schedule › maya chen (edit)

05

Versions

Every save is a new version with who made it. Nothing is overwritten. Open any earlier version, compare it, and restore it as a new one.

v4 › v5 › v6 › v7 (restored v4)

06

Change requests

An agent's edit arrives as a change request. A person reads the diff and approves or rejects it, block by block, like a pull request.

change request · payout schedule · from claude code · pending review

07

MCP

Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or your own agent connects over MCP and signs in as a person. Admins choose which tools each role may use.

app.atlascontext.ai/mcp · oauth · per-tool policy

08

Workflows

Scheduled jobs that run a model you connect, on your key. They read your sources and open change requests for a person to review.

workflow · weekly churn notes · mondays 9:00

09

Search

Search checks access before it ranks. People and agents only find what they may open, in the browser and over MCP.

search · "refund policy" · only what you can open

10

Audit log

Every change is logged with who made it and when. Admins filter the log in Settings.

audit · payout schedule · who, what, when
